contract.state: Real mean-zero L2 right-moving chiral source a on the unit circle; b=0.
contract.spatial_detector: Imported periodic tent h; not a point detector.
contract.output: J(a) = exposure^(-1) integral_delay^(delay+exposure) integral_0^1 h(x) a(x-t) dx dt.
contract.exact_input: Exact means on equal cells, interpreted as observations of the actual source.
contract.noisy_input: Observed cell means all zero; (1/N) sum_j true_mean_j^2 <= eta^2.
contract.noise_type: Deterministic aggregate L2 bound; no stochastic or per-cell-independent noise claim.
contract.endpoint_domain: Algebraically named piecewise quadratic L2 sources; not restricted to rational step data.

missing_objects: Physical calibration of source observations and detector.
A nonstandard physical constraint or dynamics producing a new recovery result.
Independent formal verification of the human infinite-dimensional proof.

literature.citation: Simon Foucart and Chunyang Liao, Optimal Recovery from Inaccurate Data in Hilbert Spaces: Regularize, but what of the Parameter? (2021).
literature.scope: Existing optimal-recovery framework; the benchmark uses elementary Hilbert projection and Cauchy-Schwarz.
